system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Logging sink that exports logs from a project to a BigQuery dataset for long-term analysis.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Logging sink that exports logs from a project to a BigQuery dataset for long-term analysis.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
imports:
- path: logging-sink.jinja

resources:
- name: log-analytics-dataset
  type: bigquery.v2.dataset
  properties:
    datasetReference:
      datasetId: log_analytics_archive
      projectId: $(ref.project-id.projectId)
    location: US
    description: "Long-term log archive dataset populated by Cloud Logging sink"
    defaultTableExpirationMs: 31536000000
    defaultPartitionExpirationMs: 31536000000
    labels:
      environment: production
      managed-by: deployment-manager
      purpose: log-analytics
    access:
    - role: OWNER
      specialGroup: projectOwners
    - role: WRITER
      specialGroup: projectWriters
    - role: READER
      specialGroup: projectReaders

- name: project-log-sink
  type: gcp-types/logging-v2:projects.sinks
  properties:
    sink: project-logs-to-bigquery
    parent: projects/[PROJECT_ID]
    uniqueWriterIdentity: true
    destination: bigquery.googleapis.com/projects/[PROJECT_ID]/datasets/$(ref.log-analytics-dataset.datasetReference.datasetId)
    description: "Exports project logs to BigQuery for long-term analytics and compliance"
    filter: |
      logName:("logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com" OR
               "logs/compute.googleapis.com" OR
               "logs/iam.googleapis.com" OR
               "logs/cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com")
      severity >= "NOTICE"
    bigqueryOptions:
      usePartitionedTables: true
  metadata:
    dependsOn:
    - log-analytics-dataset

- name: sink-writer-bq-data-editor-binding
  type: gcp-types/bigquery-v2:bigquery.datasets.patch
  properties:
    projectId: [PROJECT_ID]
    datasetId: $(ref.log-analytics-dataset.datasetReference.datasetId)
    access:
    - role: OWNER
      specialGroup: projectOwners
    - role: WRITER
      specialGroup: projectWriters
    - role: READER
      specialGroup: projectReaders
    - role: WRITER
      userByEmail: $(ref.project-log-sink.writerIdentity)
  metadata:
    dependsOn:
    - project-log-sink

outputs:
- name: sinkName
  value: $(ref.project-log-sink.name)
- name: sinkWriterIdentity
  value: $(ref.project-log-sink.writerIdentity)
- name: destinationDataset
  value: $(ref.log-analytics-dataset.datasetReference.datasetId)
- name: sinkDestination
  value: $(ref.project-log-sink.destination)
